specificFindings: Point, fruits, existence are interpreted within purpose and legacy, not geography, agriculture or biology.
Capaldi material is a song lyric; the breakup is explicitly imagined, not a documented event or experiment.
Tolstoy quotation preserves public respect and fame despite the subsequent meaning crisis; no invented loss of reputation.
Money and experiences form an analogy, not a validated exact clinical formula or proof that money causes psychological richness.
Chapter2 historical research description is not converted into a causal guarantee of health, work or lifespan.
Madison questions cover student identity, date, public/private contrast and representativeness; no question asks about suicide method.
Thoughts, attempts and deaths have distinct denominators; historical dates, approximately, somewhat and conditional frequency framing are retained.
Questions11,19,21 include exact antecedent context for pronoun, ellipsis and short evaluative sentence; extra already evidenced IDs are counted only once.
Construction and association use abstract contextual senses; college writing task is not replaced with the earlier seven-point survey; conceptual association is not universal causation.
limitations: This is a batch of ongoing whole-book work, not all gaps completed.
Stable source candidate IDs remain distinct from finalized manual sentence boundaries.
